title: A finite presentation model comparison isomorphism descends to a stage
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, F : I → CommRing a diagram with colimit A [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and i₀ ∈ I. Put A₀ = F(i₀). Let B₀, C₀ be commutative A₀-algebras and φ₀ : B₀ → C₀ a finitely presented A₀-algebra map [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Let P, Q be commutative rings with P finitely presented over Z and Q finitely presented over P. Equip B = A ⊗_{A₀} B₀ with a P-algebra structure, and suppose there is a ring isomorphism e : B ⊗_P Q ≅ A ⊗_{A₀} C₀ whose composite with B → B ⊗_P Q is id_A ⊗ φ₀. Then for some i ≥ i₀ there is a P-algebra structure on Bᵢ = F(i) ⊗_{A₀} B₀ and a ring isomorphism eᵢ : Bᵢ ⊗_P Q ≅ F(i) ⊗_{A₀} C₀ whose composite with Bᵢ → Bᵢ ⊗_P Q is id_{F(i)} ⊗ φ₀. No flatness assumption is made on P → Q.

source.place: Tag 02JO (3), proof of comparison-map descent; Tags 00QO and 05N9 (2), (3)

proof.text: Obtain the comparison system, apply the proved filtered-pushout bijectivity theorem to its colimit comparison, and obtain j with αⱼ bijective. Construct eⱼ = dⱼ inverse followed by RingEquiv.ofBijective αⱼ followed by cⱼ. The supplied left-inclusion equation is definitionally the required compatibility. Return j ≥ i ≥ i₀ and its P-algebra structure.

proof_origin.place: Reduction to comparison-system construction; filtered-pushout bijectivity proved directly from Mathlib factorization and eventual equality.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finitePresentation_model_stage {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) [HasColimit F] (i₀ : I) (B₀ : Type w) (C₀ : Type x) [CommRing B₀] [CommRing C₀] [Algebra (F.obj i₀) B₀] [Algebra (F.obj i₀) C₀] (φ₀ : B₀ →ₐ[F.obj i₀] C₀) (hfp : φ₀.toRingHom.FinitePresentation) (P Q : Type y) [CommRing P] [CommRing Q] [Algebra P Q] [Algebra.FinitePresentation ℤ P] [Algebra.FinitePresentation P Q] (aP : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra Algebra P (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)) (e : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra letI := aP (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q ≃+* (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀)) (he : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra letI := aP e.toRingHom.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom (R := P) (A := ↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) (B := Q)) = (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId ↥(colimit F) ↥(colimit F)) φ₀).toRingHom) : ∃ (i : I) (hi : i₀ ≤ i), letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra ∃ (aPi : Algebra P (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)), letI := aPi ∃ eᵢ : (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q ≃+* (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀), eᵢ.toRingHom.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom (R := P) (A := ↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) (B := Q)) = (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId (F.obj i) (F.obj i)) φ₀).toRingHom
